B1.scope: Journal integrity boundary: terminator, strict record envelope, verified-snapshot gating of replay; plus the earlier I/O poisoning, replay ACK validation and contiguous-sequence rules.
limitations: No power-loss verification: same-machine fsync plus reopen and SIGKILL only.
Driver factId continuation is not implemented; recovery replays original facts and never re-serves the same attempt.

B2.scope: An actual AttemptRunner in an independent process behind a versioned bridge (protocol v1): spawn -> bootstrap -> ready -> command -> exited, with coordinator-owned authoritative receipts.
